Having found the cloak, report back to the [[Scrying Pool]].

==Objectives==
* Investigate the [[Shining Blade Cloak|Shining Blade cloak]] at the [[Scrying Pool]].

==Rewards==
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Enter [[Watchtower Coast]] from [[Divinity Coast (outpost)]]. The [[Shining Blade Cloak]] will be on a sunken path, shortly below the first W in "Watchtower Coast" on the map. (The cloak is also close to [[Beetletun]], but the path is swarmed with [[Tengu]].)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Shining Blade Cloak
:''"Before you lie the remnants of what appears to be a Shining Blade cloak, discarded and torn. The presence of the solitary cloak provokes questions: Why was its owner alone? Were they running toward something or running away? Whatever transpired here, the scrying pool should be able to reveal it to you."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = It's time to learn the truth.
|decline = I'm suddenly no longer interested.
|ask = The site offers no further clues as to what transpired here.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Scrying Pool
:''"The scrying pool begins to react as you approach, thoughts of the Shining Blade cloak fixed firmly in your mind."''
